---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspection Results"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

data("rest_inspec")

inspection_data =
  rest_inspec %>%
  rename(borough = boro) %>%
  mutate(
    score = as.numeric(score),
    inspection_date = as.Date(
      substr(as.character(inspection_date), 1, 10)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    borough %in% c("Bronx", "Brooklyn", "Manhattan", "Queens", "Staten Island"),
    !is.na(score),
    !is.na(inspection_date)
  ) %>%
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(inspection_date, "%Y")))

grade_counts =
  inspection_data %>%
  filter(grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  count(borough, grade, name = "n_inspections")

score_by_year =
  inspection_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(mean_score = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

set.seed(1)
score_sample =
  inspection_data %>%
  slice_sample(n = min(10000, nrow(inspection_data)))
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection counts by borough and grade

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = grade_counts,
  x = ~borough,
  y = ~n_inspections,
  color = ~grade,
  type = "bar"
) %>%
  layout(
    barmode = "group",
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections")
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection scores by borough

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = score_sample,
  x = ~borough,
  y = ~score,
  color = ~borough,
  type = "box"
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score")
  )
```

### Average inspection score by year

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = score_by_year,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~mean_score,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average inspection score")
  )
```
